jobs.title: SMB Senior Program Manager
jobs.description:
SMB Senior Program Manager
Description -
Job Summary
This role is responsible for driving strategic growth in the SMB segment by cultivating high-value partner relationships, guiding sales efforts, and ensuring the effective execution of go-to-market programs. It involves gathering and analyzing market and competitor intelligence, providing insights and recommendations to country leadership, and representing HP Indonesia in regional and global program engagements to ensure local interests are well integrated. The role leads the planning, implementation, and tracking of local and global initiatives—including partner programs and end-user promotions—working cross-functionally with sales, category, marketing, and other stakeholders. It also requires monitoring program performance, managing budgets, ensuring compliance with HP policies, and maximizing ROI. Strong leadership, stakeholder management, and deep knowledge of Indonesia’s SMB and commercial market trends are essential, along with proven experience in sales, strategic planning, budgeting, and engaging with external associations to expand HP’s presence and impact.

Responsibilities

• Serve as a trusted advisor to partners by providing expert guidance on HP’s strategy, programs, and configurations across all SMB-relevant portfolios.
• Develop and manage strategic relationships with high-value partners and associations to expand HP’s footprint and long-term business opportunities in the SMB segment.
• Lead the execution of Global, regional and local SMB programs, ensuring timely implementation, stakeholder alignment, and clear internal/external communication.
• Orchestrate internal stakeholders and Works with the the team with high strategic value, performs risk assessment, and gives business rationale for the organization’s investments in different channels.
• Sets revenue targets and monitors performance against targets, and key performance indicators, and provides accurate revenue forecasts.

The role is accountable for large multi-department area(s) or location(s) with significant impact on business unit results and organizational strategy. The role serves as a key advisor to senior management, analyzing financial results, and providing strategic recommendations. The role collaborates with the leadership as a strategic partner and also drives talent management activities.

jobs.title: Global Policy & Strategy Director, GPS Team, Government Affairs & Public Policy
jobs.location: Washington, District of Columbia, United States of America
jobs.description:
Global Policy & Strategy Director, GPS Team, Government Affairs & Public Policy
Description -
Job Summary
HP Inc. is seeking to recruit a Global Policy & Strategy director to lead on global policy issues affecting HP and the technology industry. The position will be responsible for analyzing geopolitical dynamics, developing positions and strategies for addressing policies that present risks or opportunities for the company. The position is located on the Global Policy and Strategy (GPS) team within the Government Affairs and Public Policy (GA&PP) organization.
The Director for Global Policy & Strategy leads a team to develop political, geopolitical, and policy analysis to inform HP business strategy and enterprise risk management. The GPS Director will also be responsible for aligning HP policy positions internally and executing with external stakeholders.
The position will report to the Head of GA&PP. The key responsibilities include:
- Develop positions and influence strategy on a range of public policy issues including, but not limited to: trade and supply chains, global tax, additive manufacturing, and other tech policy issues in key markets
- Regularly update policy positions and collaborate with Government Affairs (GA&PP) regional teams to develop and distribute actionable content for use by advocacy teams inside and outside of GA&PP
- Monitor legislation and consult with regional GA&PP teams and subject-matter experts to determine HP’s position
- Conduct special projects of strategic importance to the company and executive leadership
- Leverage external networks, including government officials and trade associations, to develop HP policy thought leadership and create allies for advocacy strategies
- Ensure all activities are conducted according to HP’s Standards of Business Conduct.

Qualifications
- Typically a Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience and 6+ years related experience or Master’s degree and 4-6 years of experience
- Experience developing and implementing government relations strategies for companies, political organizations; or relevant government service
- Expert in global trade and supply chain issues.
- Comfortable in a fast-paced and distributed business environment providing advice and counsel to senior management, and presenting to senior level boards and committees
- Exceptional written and oral communications. Able to present to internal and external audience in a way that makes complex issues easy to understand and action. skills and a proven track record of producing high quality content and materials
- Experience in executive communications
- Knowledge of international institutions, government stakeholders, and deep industry knowledge (competitors, supply chain, and other stakeholders).
- Outstanding organizational abilities including the capacity to collaborate with regional government affairs functions, and manage several different workstreams at one time
- Intellectual curiosity, flexibility to learn and manage new issues.
- Fluency in English, other languages an asset
- Some travel may be required

The pay range for this role is $159,650 to $255,450 USD annually with additional opportunities for pay in the form of bonus and/or equity (applies to United States of America candidates only). Pay varies by work location, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience.

This position is located on-site in the HP Washington D.C. office.

Benefits:
HP offers a comprehensive benefits package for this position, including:
- Health insurance
- Dental insurance
- Vision insurance
- Long term/short term disability insurance
- Employee assistance program
- Flexible spending account
- Life insurance
- Generous time off policies, including;
- 4-12 weeks fully paid parental leave based on tenure
- 11 paid holidays
- Additional flexible paid vacation and sick leave ( US benefits overview )

The compensation and benefits information is accurate as of the date of this posting. The Company reserves the right to modify this information at any time, with or without notice, subject to applicable law.

jobs.title: PS Strategic Alliances Funding Analytics & Modeling Business Manager
jobs.location: Hsinchu, Hsinchu City, Taiwan Region; Austin, Texas, United States of America
jobs.description:
PS Strategic Alliances Funding Analytics & Modeling Business Manager
Description -
HP is looking for a highly analytical and results-oriented Business Manager to drive HP strategic direction and optimize significant investments with our PS Strategic Alliances partners. This pivotal role combines broad strategic oversight with specific responsibilities for managing critical funding programs related to our global CPU, GPU, and OS purchases. You will be instrumental in shaping our company's future by transforming raw data into actionable insights and regularly presenting these insights and strategic recommendations at the executive level.

You will oversee comprehensive data, conduct rigorous analysis, and thoroughly test hypotheses to inform our most critical choice points. You will work with cross-functional teams to facilitate meaningful projects and programs, ensuring operational goals are met, and our strategy remains competitive and adaptable in a rapidly changing business landscape.

This role demands a unique blend of strategic foresight, analytical prowess, financial acumen, and strong relationship management skills.

Key Responsibilities
- Business optimization: Formulate recommendations to optimize business and financial performance.

- Strategic leadership: Lead the identification of research and analytical needs, structure strategic approaches, and develop project strategies and tactics. Provide thought leadership and contributes to expanding the knowledge base.

- Project management: Oversee large, cross-functional teams, manage communications, and ensure timely project delivery. Develop project guidelines, contingency plans, objectives, and deliverables.

- Executive collaboration: Advise business executives on strategy formulation, risk management, and growth opportunities. Foster cross-functional collaboration to align strategy and execution.

Specifics of the role:
- Develop comprehensive financial models to project annual budgets for Alliance partner spend and funding (rebates, MDF, NRE).

- Create and utilize dynamic analytical models to support negotiations for annual funding frameworks, driving operational implementation of resulting frameworks with category and finance teams.

- Lead cross-functional teams across Alliances, Finance, and Category to identify and address gaps against quarterly savings targets, ensuring one version of the truth.

- Manage quarterly Alliances metrics , influencing executive-level targets and communicating progress to stakeholders.

- Oversee the complete lifecycle of Alliances analytics , including processes and big data tools, for key metrics such as shipments, spend, rebates, and market share, facilitating critical data-driven conversations and decisions with internal and external executives.

- Lead projects focused on reporting, analytics, and process improvement to optimize strategic decision-making regarding partner utilization, cost efficiencies, and gross margin.

Knowledge and Skills
- Detail-oriented with strong analytical skills and business acumen; experienced in developing financial models, leading analysis, and explaining options and implications.

- Highly motivated self-starter capable of working under pressure, prioritizing workload to meet deadlines, operating independently with minimal guidance, and exercising extreme ownership for projects and results.

- Excellent project and program management skills, including project structuring, timing, and managing multiple work streams independently.

- Demonstrated executive presence and executive communication skills.

- Exceptional influencing and collaboration skills, with demonstrated ability to navigate matrix environments and forge strong partnerships across organizations (internal and external to HP) to achieve optimal results in complex programs.

- Comfortable operating effectively at both tactical and strategic levels.

- High proficiency with standard Office tools. Excellent PC skills in Excel (including but not limited to lookups, complex/compound equations, logical equations, macros, pivot tables, and the ability to understand/build/edit complex financial models).

- Experience with data analysis tools such as Tableau or PowerBI highly preferred.

Education & Experience Recommended
- Four-year or Graduate Degree in Business Administration, Finance, Economics, or any other related discipline or commensurate work experience or demonstrated competence.

- 10+ years of work experience, preferably in strategic management, strategic planning and implementation, consulting, market research, or a related field.

Preferred Certifications
- Project Management Professional (PMP) Certification.

jobs.title: Sustainability Customer Success Intern
jobs.location: Sant Cugat del Valles, Barcelona, Spain
jobs.description:
Sustainability Customer Success Intern
Description -
At HP, our ambition is to become the world’s most sustainable and just technology company. Sustainable Impact is fundamental to HP’s reinvention journey – fuelling our innovation and growth, strengthening our business for the long term, and enabling us to develop and deliver the best solutions for our customers.
We are committed to developing and delivering an environmentally sustainable product portfolio, improving the sustainability of our own global operations, and partnering with our suppliers and with our customers to reduce their environmental impact.
We believe that our actions should address some of the greatest challenges we face as a society, including climate change, human rights and digital equity.
We are proud of the progress we have made on our Sustainable Impact commitments but know there’s still more work to do.
Over the next decade, HP will stand for a new era of progress— where climate change is reversed, human rights are universally protected, and digital equity democratizes opportunity for all.
This is an opportunity to be part of that journey and to make a real positive and sustainable impact.

You can find more information on HP’s Sustainable Impact strategy and commitments at www.hp.com/sustainability , and in our latest Sustainable Impact Report .

Mission

The Sustainability Customer Success team mission is to efficiently support our customers on their sustainability journey, and turn this into a demonstrable competitive advantage for HP, by driving our operational excellence across our sustainable impact sales & business development support activities, processes, and tools.

Key Responsibilities

The intern will support part of our sales enablement programs and operations, mostly notably:
- Sustainable Impact Champions network – a network formed to boost sustainability knowledge across our sales ecosystem, the champions are the first port of call to their teams when it comes to sustainability. The intern will help manage the network, supporting activities such as training development, newsletters and communication efforts
- Sustainability Sales tools – the intern will support the team in identifying and compiling key content needed for sales tools development, coordinate revisions and feedbacks
- Indicators monthly and quarterly reporting dashboards – will help consolidate content and metrics to deliver the monthly markets and global dashboards

Requirements & essential skills

- Passion for sustainability and drive to make a positive difference.
- Enrolled in a local university doing a Bachelor or Master in environmental studies and sustainability, communications, business administration, marketing, engineering or a related field
- Customer centric mindset
- Analytical skills and process oriented
- Enthusiasm, ability and willingness to learn and adapt to new challenges.
- Teamworking collaborator

Benefits
- Flexible schedule to adapt to bachelor’s or master’s degree academic program. Part time or full time.
- Opportunity to learn in an international organization with colleagues from all over the world.
- Diverse internal growth and career opportunities.
- A Women Network that organizes activities all year long, such as the promotion of STEM vocations among girls.
- A Young employee Network (YEN) which hosts fun events on a regular basis.
- Sports center (indoor and outdoor); gym, squash courts, tennis courts, basketball courts and regular fitness classes such as Yoga, Pilates, etc.
- We also dedicate time and resources to contribute to our community through Corporate Volunteering activities.
- We have an onsite Doctor and medical team for our employees, including services such as nutrition, physiotherapy, and general health.

Legal Entity: GBU

About HP

HP is a technology company that operates in more than 170 countries around the world united in creating technology that makes life better for everyone, everywhere.

You’re out to reimagine and reinvent what’s possible—in your career as well as the world around you. So are we. We love taking on tough challenges, disrupting the status quo, and creating what’s next. We’re in search of talented people who are inspired by big challenges, driven to learn and grow, and dedicated to making a meaningful difference.

Our history: HP’s commitment to diversity, equity and inclusion – it’s just who we are. From the boardroom to factory floor, we create a culture where everyone is respected and where people can be themselves, while being a part of something bigger than themselves. We celebrate the notion that you can belong at HP and bring your authentic self to work each and every day. When you do that, you’re more innovative and that helps grow our bottom line. Come to HP and thrive!

Thanks for taking the time to review our job, if you think it is a match to your experience and interests please apply today, we are eager to learn more about you. If you know a friend who may be a fit for the job, please refer them.

jobs.title: Customer Success Manager Apprentice m/f
jobs.description:
Customer Success Manager Apprentice m/f
Description -
Who we are?
HP creates new possibilities for technology to have a meaningful impact on people, businesses, governments and society. The world’s largest technology company and one of the Fortune 100 Best Companies to Work For list in 2024, HP brings together a portfolio that spans printing, personal computing, software, services and IT infrastructure to serve more than 1 billion customers in over 170 countries on six continents.
HP invents, engineers, and delivers technology solutions that drive business value, create social value, and improve the lives of our clients. At HP, we know that our people and values are the most important elements in this success. And we want you to add your voice and imagination to our mission. Learn more http://www.hp.com/fr

What can we do together?
You will join an international team of people based in different countries from Spain to Norway and supporting the largest account in Western Europe.
This team is part of a global services organization in HP ; our mission is to sell and manage services contracts for the largest corporate customers of HP. Those services contracts include Managed Print Services (“MPS”), the full management of office printers for a corporate account, Managed Device Services (“MDS”) the full management of PCs, and Managed Collaboration Services (“MCS”) the full management of meeting rooms for a given customer.
The Customer Success Manager (“CSM”) is the primary customer interface for those managed services contracts and is responsible for helping customers obtain the optimum value of the contracted services, as well as maximizing HP share of wallet within the account.

Responsibilities:
Typically supporting 1 or 2 global accounts, your missions will be the following:
- Maintains high-level of customer loyalty and builds trust and integrity in relationships with clients;
- Identifying/confirming customer success criteria – update customer success plan, expansion needs and identify key influencers and decision makers;
- Manage the customer contract on daily basis, ensuring all services activities delivered are under control;
- Detect business upsell opportunities (for HP strategic offering). Work in collaboration with other sales function to win those opportunities;
- Work on contract renewalSupports quarterly account review with customer stakeholders to report the major KPIs and work on improvement;
- Accountable for P&L management, remediation, forecasting revenue, cost, growth.
- Responsible for supporting pre-sales, drive adoption, increase utilization.
- P&L Management, supports renewals.

Who you are?
- Master's degree student in International Business or Finance.
- Typically 0-2 years experience
- Understands market intelligence regarding competitors, products, and offerings.
- Works as a member of a team in providing support and giving input regarding account opportunities.
- Negotiation skills and ability to frame the value proposition for the customer.
- Product demonstration, customer training, and product installation skills.

Why joining HP France?
At HP France, you will be immersed in an inspiring workplace where all our people love to be, collaborate well together and where they can learn, grow and develop professionally as well as personally. We offer empowering responsibilities. You will have the opportunity to evolve through your commitment, your skills and your sense of initiative! This position can be the 1st step in a great career within our teams!
Joining us also means a great work-life balance and benefits such as meal vouchers, discounts on HP products and more!
Driven by a strong corporate culture, our employees are involved in numerous initiatives through internal networks (Next Gen, Women@hp, workplace well-being team, etc.) and external volunteering (Nos Quartiers ont du Talent, Hour of Code).
HP is also committed to an equal opportunities policy, from recruitment to career development. Job offers are open to all, including people with disabilities.
Our promise: To create a diverse and inclusive working environment! So, what are you waiting for?
Based in Meudon (tramway T2 stop Brimborion), our campus offers collaborative, creative and ultra-connected open spaces!

Beginning of apprenticeship : September 2025

Description -
Job Summary
• This role is responsible for independently assessing intricate matters on HR policies and facilitating HR programs operational and strategic plans. The role contributes to HR program implementation, innovates development strategies, and guides managers in addressing complex performance matters. The role ensures compliance, coaches on policies, and provides insightful analysis to HR leadership through well-prepared reports.

Responsibilities
• Performs complex and occasionally highly complex analysis for a HR function or business, utilizing strong business understanding to achieve objectives effectively.
• Consults with business leaders to deliver complex human resources policies and programs within businesses and local environment.
• Delivers a comprehensive package of human resources programs by interpreting corporate initiatives for business and local regulatory needs.
• Contributes to implementation of multiple programs simultaneously while managing regional priority project teams.

• Assesses the overall Human Resources management Programs, (classification, staffing and recruitment, pay and leave administration, record-keeping processes including Human Resources Management System) to implement strategic ideas that will improve business processes.

jobs.title: Financial Analyst-Control and Compliances
jobs.description:
Financial Analyst-Control and Compliances
Description -

Job Summary
This role is under the newly setup Rebates Controls and Compliance Tower for Personal Systems. This role is responsible for executing the SOX controls and ensuring compliance of the Global Commodity Rebates for HP. This includes active engagement with multiple stakeholders including Internal Audit and External Audit. This role would also include Financial Planning & Analysis for Commodity Rebates.

Responsibilities
- As a Control Performer, confirm effective execution of SOX controls applicable to the scope of the activity
- Control Performer/Reviewer for Commodity Rebates, ensuring that all rebate contracts are available and complete with all required rebates terms and conditions.
- Control Performer/Reviewer for Commodity Rebates, ensuring that all the data used for rebate accrual calculations are complete and accurate
- Ensure complete and accurate data is available for budgeting and forecasting
- Data analysis on Rebates Forecast vs actuals, accruals vs actuals and use insights to improve future forecasting and accruals.
- Confirm effective controls and compliance in the areas of accrual accounting, supplier rebates claim management, Balance Sheet account reviews as required per HP’s policies and procedures.
- Conducts comprehensive financial statement analysis for Supply Chain managed activities, provide valuable analytical insights to key stakeholders to influence business decisions and drive actions for resolution.
- Establishes and maintain relationships with key stakeholders and cross functional teams, supports policy and process enhancement, identifying opportunities for improved efficiency and organizational growth.
- Provides information and counsel in the areas of controls and compliance.
- Responsible for leading, motivating, and developing team members.

Education and Experience Required:
- First level university degree with a focus in accounting or business; advanced degree and accounting certification (e.g., CMA/CPA/Chartered accountant) required.
- Typically 6+ years of experience as an auditor (external or internal) or in controls & compliance
- Typically experienced in more than one finance function
- Ability to work across time zones
